ClientContext.reason: ClientContext was a type alias of Cordis Context.

createSnapshotStore.reason: The React-free store engine moved to client-store.

defineStore.reason: The declarative store factory moved to client-store.

ObservableSnapshot.reason: The observable store contract moved to client-store.

SnapshotStore.reason: The writable store contract moved to client-store.

shallowEqual.reason: The store equality helper moved to client-store.

SessionId.reason: Session identity is owned by the Session domain.

ISessions.reason: Session ownership moved to the Session Controller and its snapshots changed.

Session.reason: The Client Session object and lifecycle moved to the Session Controller.

SessionBinding.reason: Session bindings are now Controller-owned lifetimes.

SessionListState.reason: The list state moved and no longer owns Conversation or pending-interaction facts.

SessionSummary.reason: The Session summary is now a Controller-owned control snapshot.

UseProjection.reason: Projection sources are now exposed by Session Controller bindings and adapted by ui-session.

IWorkspaces.reason: Workspace ownership moved to the Workspace Controller and navigation policy moved to ui-workspace.

WorkspaceId.reason: Workspace identity is re-exported by the Workspace Controller.

WorkspaceView.reason: Workspace snapshots are Controller-owned and their shape changed.

ConversationNode.reason: Conversation assembly moved out of Session snapshots into ui-conversation.

ConversationSnapshot.reason: Conversation is now an independent target-neutral source.

PendingInteraction.reason: Approval and Question now publish domain-owned pending interactions through ui-session.

PendingWait.reason: The Runtime PendingWait aggregate was removed; pending domains own their payloads.
